hook_text: A crab is hard as a rock, but it has no bones at all. So what is it?
clip_script: Rock pools in Gqeberha. A crab, a mussel, a starfish, a bluebottle on the sand. None of them has a backbone. They are invertebrates. Some are soft, some wear a hard shell on the outside. Now the museum. A fish skeleton, a bird skeleton, a dolphin skeleton. Every one has a backbone. They are vertebrates: fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals. Feel the bumps down your back. Which group are you in?
visual_style: Whiteboard split into two columns, invertebrates and vertebrates, with animals sliding into the right column one by one.
mood: Playful, like a sorting game show.
pacing: Fast sort of beach animals, then museum skeletons, then a question to the viewer.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort ten animals from your neighbourhood.
